curation.review_notes: Security: PASS. Read/grep/glob only; no network, no exec, no writes. The checklist itself targets secrets, injection, auth bypass, dependency and PII risks — the skill's content is defensive, with no prompt-injection vectors (no instructions to ignore safety boundaries). Quality: PASS. Severity guide (BLOCKER/WARN/OK) makes findings actionable; checklist items map to concrete grep-able patterns (sk-, AKIA, -----BEGIN, eval/exec sinks). Documentation: PASS. Five-section checklist is complete and self-contained; zen-plugin.json manifest accurate. Maintenance: PASS. Maintained in-repo by ZenCode, versioned with the CLI. Note: the checklist is a heuristic aid, not a guarantee — pairs well with `zen audit` for pre-run scanning.
